notes.title: 😻 Quilts & Cats of Calico Revealed! A New Board Game Adaptation is Coming 😻
notes.content:
[h2]Our upcoming project, [i]Quilts & Cats of Calico[/i], reveals on Steam![/h2]

[previewyoutube=gTkhNZk4xQ4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Check it out below and add it to your wishlist to stay up to date.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1993180

[h2][b]What is [i]Quilts & Cats of Calico[/i]?[/b][/h2]
[h3][i]Quilts & Cats of Calico[/i] is a wholesome digital adaptation of the award-winning puzzle board game Calico for 1-4 players. Your goal is to collect as many points as possible by sewing the best quilt designs that appeal to cute but fussy cats. Pet and customize kitties, play solo or with others and explore the intriguing world where cats come first and people compete with machines![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583524/948d1e11a4baa05c5b090e372c8efff5b71d48bf.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583524/08222f6eb05bf3622b4c72a07b2deee7acdc9326.jpg[/img]

[h3]For some time now, our great ambition has been to create the best board game adaptations. For us, creating a digital version of Wingspan was and still is a great developing adventure full of birds and captivating nature. [i]Quilts & Cats of Calico[/i] is the next title of its kind that we will be making after Wingspan. We hope you will be charmed by the cuddly cats of [i]Quilts & Cats of Calico[/i] as much as we are.[/h3]

[h2][b]Last but not least[/b][/h2]

[h3]We also invite you to the [url=https://discord.gg/USgaSw58Fv][i]Quilts & Cats of Calico[/i] Discord server[/url]. You’ll find there a [b]sign-up form for the game's beta tests on Steam[/b], about which more information will be coming soon. [/h3]

notes.title: Tetsumo Party launch celebration! Patch introducing a new tutorial and a bunch of fixes is now live!
notes.content:
Hi there!

To celebrate the launch of Tetsumo Party we are also updating Die for Valhalla! with a bunch of fixes and a new tutorial :)

[b]Patch notes:[/b]
Better tutorial
Faster loading times 
Minor bugfixes
Level boost for lower level characters joining a game (other people can join your ongoing session and feel powerful too!)

I hope you will enjoy the patch! 

If you want to talk about the update feel invited to our discord [url=discord.gg/monstercouch]discord.gg/monstercouch[/url]

Check out Tetsumo Party:
[url]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1006120[/url]

Have fun!

notes.title: Patch "Kickstarter" is now live!
notes.content:
Hi there!

Over the last few weeks we have worked on adding a new mode to Die for Valhalla! Here it comes :) Challenges are here and along with them the Steam Leaderboards integration. Play them and let us know what do you think of them! Would you like to see more challenges like this? :)

Hardcore mode tweaks - this patch includes a number of fixes to the Hardcore mode, we think of this as an ongoing process to improve the Hardcore mode so let us know how do you feel about it.

We have also fixed a bunch of other things, details below. If you’re encountering anything wonky in the game reach me at krzysiek@monstercouch.com or through the Steam community. 

You can also post your wishes and vote on them here: https://www.stomt.com/valhalla 

Have fun!



Patch Notes:

[list]
[*]Challenges: Kickstarter and Portal
[*]Steam Leaderboards integration
[*]Hardcore mode flow tweaks: if you die and continue from the same save you will not have to re-watch the cutscenes and introductions you have already seen
[*]Hardcore mode difficulty: enemies are more deadly and you will encounter [*]more ranged ones
[*]Fixes for empty encounters
[*]Less waiting for enemies to get on screen
[*]New Deathmatch levels
[*]Disable screenshake option
[*]Map popups tweaks
[*]Valkyries have different starting stats
[/list]

notes.title: Patch “Turkish is here” is now live! You can become a language hero too!
notes.content:
Hi there!

You can now play the game in Turkish! Thank you Serhat! (You can check out his page here: http://bagimsizoyunceviri.blogspot.com.tr/p/about.html).

If you would like to help us add your language to Die for Valhalla! you can help us here:
http://translate.dieforvalhalla.com/

We’re open to all kinds of suggestions. :)

We have also fixed a bunch of other things, details below. If you’re encountering anything wonky in the game reach me at krzysiek@monstercouch.com or through the Steam community.

You can also post your wishes and vote on them here: https://www.stomt.com/valhalla

We’re also working on the next patch adding new challenges and leaderboards. Coming soon! :)

Have fun!



Patch Notes:

Turkish language added.
Translation tweaks.
Third save slot added.
Time counting fixes (for minimized or paused game).

notes.title: Patch “Little Head” is now live!
notes.content:
Hi there!

You can now use the exploding little heads against their friends to cause explosive chain reactions!     

To all you achievement hunters - we’ve hotfixed the boss achievements and you can get them all now, sorry for the delay.

We have also fixed a bunch of other things, details below. If you’re encountering anything wonky in the game reach me at contact@monstercouch.com or through the Steam community. 

You can also post your wishes and vote on them here: https://www.stomt.com/valhalla 

Have fun!


Patch Notes:

- Typos and glyph icons in texts
- Translation tweaks
- Fixed infinite healing loop in some situations
- Tweaked some boss fights
- Fixed a crash that might occur after switching clans
- Fixed a crash that might occur when a follower kills an enemy
- Minor visual tweaks
- Explosive enemies now deal area damage to everything
- Boss achievements are now unlocking properly
- Minor bug fixes and performance tweaks
